{{Quote|I made forgot more toxins that that bloodworm Isen imagines!|[[Darth Maladi]], about [[Vul Isen]]|<ref name="War2">[[Legacy — War 2|''Legacy — War'' 2]]</ref>}}
A '''bloodworm''' was a type of [[Worm/Legends|worm]] that could be [[Farm/Legends|farmed]].<ref name="Tethan">''[[The Clone Wars: Decide Your Destiny: Tethan Battle Adventure]]''</ref> The [[Riddellian bloodworm]] was a type of bloodworm<ref name="Mindor">''[[Luke Skywalker and the Shadows of Mindor]]''</ref> from<ref name="Planetnamia">{{Planetnamia|species=[[Riddellian bloodworm]]|system=[[Riddellia system/Legends|Riddellia system]]|legends=1}}</ref> the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories']] [[Albanin sector/Legends|Albanin sector]]<ref name="EAOC">{{SW|url=news/star-wars-the-essential-atlas-online-companion|text=''Star Wars: The Essential Atlas'' Online Companion|int=Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion}}</ref> that could be baked on a [[Temperature/Legends|hot]] [[fry-rock]].<ref name="Mindor" />

==Behind the scenes==
{{Quote|With thisss much cyssstalline ''[sic]'' vertex we could buy out Jabba the Hutt and ssstill have enough left over to sssset up our own bloodworm farmsss.|Quar Rohk, to Janu Godalhi and a youngling in an adventure path in ''The Clone Wars: Decide Your Destiny: Tethan Battle Adventure''|<ref name="Tethan" />}}
The first mention of bloodworms in the ''[[Star Wars]]'' franchise came with a mention of the Riddellian bloodworms in [[Matthew Stover]]'s [[2008]] novel ''[[Luke Skywalker and the Shadows of Mindor]]''.<ref name="Mindor" /> Bloodworms in general were subsequently mentioned in [[The Clone Wars: Decide Your Destiny: Tethan Battle Adventure|''Tethan Battle Adventure'']], [[Sue Behrent]]'s [[2010]] entry in the ''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars: Decide Your Destiny]]'' series of choose-your-own-adventure books. In one adventure path the reader may take in the book's story, the [[Unidentified Tethan youngling|protagonist]], a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Tethan]] [[Youngling/Legends|youngling]], is kidnapped by an [[Pwi'lin|enslaver]] and taken from their [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] [[Teth/Legends|Teth]]&mdash;on which the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] forces are [[Battle of Teth/Legends|clashing]] as part of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]&mdash;to be [[Slavery/Legends|sold]] in the [[Cloud City/Legends|Cloud City]] [[City/Legends|settlement]]<ref name="Tethan" /> on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Bespin/Legends|Bespin]].<ref name="TEA">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref> In Cloud City, the youngling escapes, but shortly thereafter, the Confederacy [[Battle of Bespin (Clone Wars)|attacks]] the settlement. At that point, the Tethan can try and find a hiding place from which to also attack the aggressors, an option that ''Tethan Battle Adventure'' describes as "hide somewhere and blast as many Separatist bloodworms as you can before they find you."<ref name="Tethan" />

In another path, the youngling, accompanied by<ref name="Tethan" /> the Human<ref name="DB">{{DB|character|janugodalhi|Godalhi, Janu}}</ref> [[Historian/Legends|historian]] and security expert [[Janu Godalhi/Legends|Janu Godalhi]] and [[Trandoshan/Legends|Trandoshan]] [[Thief/Legends|thief]] [[Quar Rohk]], investigate the [[B'omarr Monastery]] on Teth in order to discover any links between the Confederacy and [[Jabba's criminal empire/Legends|Jabba Desilijic Tiure's criminal empire]]. When they finally discover a cache of valuable [[Crystalline vertex/Legends|crystalline vertex]] [[Mineral/Legends|mineral]] that Jabba has invested in the Confederacy's [[DS-1 Orbital Battle Station/Legends|superweapon]] development plans, Rohk, who is revealed to be only interested in obtaining the [[Crystal/Legends|crystalline]] vertex for himself, excitedly exclaims that the trio would now be wealthy enough to set up their own farms of bloodworms. The discovery soon leads to a confrontation, however, in which either Rohk is the only survivor or all three of them [[Death/Legends|perish]].<ref name="Tethan" />
